title: Command body
statement: A command whose change neither the pattern's fixed part nor its settings can say (a move, a link with checks, a refusal no rule states) MUST be written by hand against this contract: it changes its one aggregate, loaded whole, refuses with every reason and changes nothing when it refuses, and holds the aggregate to its rules before it saves.

title: Aggregate rules
statement: Each aggregate's rules MUST check every instance they are given against the aggregate's invariants and return every problem, each named as its refusal names it, changing nothing.

title: Instance mapping
statement: Each aggregate MUST say how its kinds sit in an instance (its shape), build each instance whole from its own stored records and give back exactly those records, so that its loading, saving and pattern commands are derived from it.

title: Query answer
statement: Each query MUST answer from what its read model's reader gives it alone, and refuse with a reason when its input names nothing the reader holds.

title: Repository
statement: An aggregate whose repository the generator cannot derive (one kept in browser storage, a file of its own or memory, or one whose instance is not its kinds' rows) MUST load its instance whole from its one data store and save exactly that instance's records back, never a part of it.

title: Projection
statement: Each read model's projection MUST fill its read model from the records and events it reads alone, keep it current as they change, and write nothing else.

title: Reader
statement: Each read model's reader MUST give its query handlers exactly its read model's records, from its one data store, and nothing of another read model.

title: Stored shape
statement: Each entity's or read model's stored shape (its table, or its row type where no table holds it) MUST hold exactly its fields, keyed by its ID, with every check its data store can hold.

title: Domain code
statement: Each value type, event type, predicate, domain service and policy handler MUST say in code exactly what its record in the domain model says (the values a value object allows, an event's fields, a specification's statement, a service's work, a policy's one command), reading only what that record reads.

title: Endpoint
statement: A route the generator does not derive (a stream, a whole read or an undo) and the client code that calls it MUST expose exactly its one command or query and answer as the derived routes do.

title: Adapter
statement: Each adapter MUST be the only code that reaches its integration, handing it only what the steps that exchange with it name.

title: Engine module
statement: Code the engine's slices share, the check engine's among it, MUST hold no rule of an aggregate or check of its own, only what several slices need to load, write, check and answer as this pattern says.

title: Command line shell
statement: The command line and the MCP tools MUST reach each command and query through its one definition, adding only how arguments are read and answers printed.

title: Generator
statement: Each generator MUST write its files from the records and the schema alone, the same every time, each marked as generated, and refuse what the records cannot derive, naming it.

title: Entry point
statement: Each entry point MUST only start its interface (mount, serve or open it) and hold no rule of its own.

title: UI component
statement: Each UI component MUST build the view requirements it names from the generic components and tokens, reading its records only through its view's queries.

title: App module
statement: Code the app's components share MUST know no kind of record and hold no rule of an aggregate.

title: Build tooling
statement: Each build, check or test configuration and script MUST build, check or run the product's own code as written, adding no rule the patterns and standards do not state.

title: Editor
statement: Each aggregate's editor MUST draw its forms from its commands' derived fields, built from the shared inputs, and add only what an input cannot say: labels, long text and choices.

title: Record body
statement: Each aggregate's record view MUST show, below the shared title, kind and links, what its own view requirements ask of its record, reading only through its aggregate's queries.

title: Shell module
statement: Code the desktop shell's commands share MUST take a page's action only by a known action and an ID, and hold no rule of an aggregate.
